newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde - Aug 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde - Aug 6.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Investigation relaunched into radioactivity at La Hague nuclear reprocessing plant.
-- Pick-up in Paris office property sector still not certain even if the worst of the crisis is over and despite recent sales.
